description: Issuer status reducer sequences (SPEC-v2 §5.3). Each scenario starts from empty state for issuer_id. Steps run in order against one reducer; a rejected step leaves state unchanged. expect_state asserts only the listed fields; accepted_set and deny_union are sorted certificate IDs. Query evidence uses the deterministic per-reference selection rules of SPEC-v2 §6.

operations.apply_list: verify the list under status_key bound to issuer_id at status_key_epoch, then apply it at time now
operations.apply_push: verify the push under status_key bound to issuer_id at status_key_epoch, then apply it at time now
operations.query: StatusResult for CertificateRef(issuer_id, cert_id) at now, under the scenario policy unless policy overrides it
operations.transition_epoch: caller-authenticated status-key replacement to status_key at status_key_epoch

scenarios.name: bootstrap_and_contiguous_push
scenarios.description: fresh snapshot bootstraps; a floor+1 push extends accepted state; an exact duplicate push is idempotent

scenarios.name: empty_revocation_accepted_base
scenarios.description: an empty accepted snapshot is retained as the accepted base and supports not_revoked

scenarios.name: gap_returns_indeterminate
scenarios.description: a push above floor+1 is a gap: indeterminate (never not_revoked) until a fresh full snapshot at or above max_observed_sequence reconciles it

scenarios.name: push_before_bootstrap_and_bootstrap_below_observed
scenarios.description: a push before any snapshot is observed state only; a snapshot below the highest observed sequence cannot bootstrap; a later snapshot at that sequence can

scenarios.name: pre_bootstrap_push_then_same_sequence_snapshot
scenarios.description: a sequence-1 push before bootstrap never yields not_revoked; a fresh snapshot at that sequence containing it bootstraps

scenarios.name: late_join_snapshot_bootstrap
scenarios.description: a verifier with no floor bootstraps from a fresh snapshot at a high sequence

scenarios.name: same_sequence_heartbeat_and_fork_after_bootstrap
scenarios.description: identical-set heartbeats refresh only forward in updated_at; a differing set at the floor is a fork that cannot self-reconcile; recovery requires a fresh snapshot above fork_sequence; replaying the fork marker after recovery is a no-op

scenarios.name: same_sequence_fork_before_bootstrap
scenarios.description: two authenticated snapshots at one sequence with different sets are a fork even before bootstrap

scenarios.name: push_then_snapshot_same_sequence
scenarios.description: push at S followed by a snapshot at S that equals the cumulative set is consistent

scenarios.name: snapshot_then_push_same_sequence
scenarios.description: a push first received after the snapshot at its sequence is recorded without reconciliation when represented in the accepted set

scenarios.name: snapshot_then_conflicting_push_same_sequence
scenarios.description: a push at an accepted sequence naming a certificate absent from the accepted set is a fork

scenarios.name: conflicting_push_at_floor
scenarios.description: a different push body at the accepted floor is a fork; an exact semantic duplicate with new signature bytes is idempotent

scenarios.name: snapshot_between_floor_and_observed
scenarios.description: a fresh snapshot strictly between the floor and a higher observed push advances the floor but stays indeterminate until caught up

scenarios.name: lower_sequence_snapshot_omits_observed_revocation
scenarios.description: a snapshot at S that omits a revocation observed at or before S is equivocation and a fork

scenarios.name: below_floor_equivocation
scenarios.description: a push below the floor introducing a revocation absent from the accepted set is a fork at max(previous_fork_sequence, current_floor, conflicting_object_sequence); a same-floor snapshot cannot clear it; recovery only above fork_sequence

scenarios.name: stale_and_future_dated
scenarios.description: accepted state beyond the age bound is stale; a future-dated push makes status unavailable until a fresh snapshot reconciles

scenarios.name: exclusive_age_deadline
scenarios.description: a snapshot is fresh only while now < updated_at + max_status_age (SPEC-v2 §2.5): one second before the deadline it is current, at the deadline it is stale

scenarios.name: exclusive_next_update_deadline
scenarios.description: a snapshot is fresh only while now < next_update (SPEC-v2 §2.5): one second before next_update it is current, at next_update it is stale

scenarios.name: unconfigured_freshness_bounds
scenarios.description: status is unavailable when either finite freshness bound is not configured

scenarios.name: non_fresh_snapshot_reconciliation
scenarios.description: a non-fresh snapshot above the floor requires reconciliation; a consistent non-fresh snapshot at or below the floor does not

scenarios.name: forward_snapshot_acceptance
scenarios.description: with no reconciliation pending a fresh forward snapshot containing every observation replaces the accepted base

scenarios.name: epoch_transition
scenarios.description: a status-key epoch transition resets accepted snapshot, set, and floor while retaining the issuer-wide deny union and prior evidence; late old-epoch objects are rejected; the new epoch bootstraps only from a snapshot that carries the retained deny union; a retired status key cannot be rebound
